body:
WHAT
The vision model's API key is stored in a workspace `.env` under one environment variable name. The app writes it; the engine reads it. Both sides hard-code the name `MAGENTRA_VISION_API_KEY`, separate from the main connection's key variable.

WHY
A mismatch means the app writes a key the engine never reads, so image description fails with an auth error while the key sits unused in .env.

WHERE
engine/core/src/config/settings.ts — `export const VISION_API_KEY_ENV`, consumed by `resolveVisionApiKey()`; app/main/config.js — `const VISION_API_KEY_ENV` (exported).

TEST CHECKLIST
1. Import both constants and assert strict equality ('MAGENTRA_VISION_API_KEY').
2. Assert the vision variable differs from DEFAULT_API_KEY_ENV / MAGENTRA_API_KEY on both sides, so one name never serves two keys.
3. Set process.env[VISION_API_KEY_ENV]='vk' and call resolveVisionApiKey({visionConnection:{apiKey:'stored'}}); the result is 'vk' (env wins), and with the variable unset it is 'stored'.
4. With the variable set to whitespace and no stored key, resolveVisionApiKey returns undefined (blank is not a key).
